name: Tabata This
source_text:
Tabata This
Tabata (20 seconds of work, 10 seconds of rest, for 8 rounds) on each of the following, resting exactly 1 minute between movements:
Pull-ups
Push-ups
Sit-ups
Air Squats

Score is the sum of the lowest number of reps completed in any round of each movement.
